get.description:
GDPR Art. 20-style export of the requester's own data. DMs: only messages the user sent,
plus conversation metadata, because received messages are the other party's personal data.

delete.description: 'Delete for me': hides history for the caller only; the other member's copy is untouched.
Unsend: sender-only, scoped in SQL. Content is erased for everyone; a tombstone remains.

post.description:
Browsers post ``application/csp-report``; this route deliberately bypasses StrictRoute's JSON
content-type rule. Only a handful of fields are logged, and they are truncated.
